title: 50agents vs Relevance AI for sales teams | 50agents
description: Relevance AI sells sales AI agent teams from $19 a month billed yearly; 50agents builds single AI agents, automations and apps, free to start.
answer: Pick Relevance AI if you are a revenue team that wants ready-made sales AI agent teams wired into Salesforce, HubSpot and Gong.
Pick 50agents if you want one job done at a time, such as follow-ups on quiet deals, built from plain words; it is free to start, and Relevance AI has no free plan.
ask: Set up an AI agent that finds my HubSpot deals with no reply in 5 days every weekday at 9:00 and drafts a follow-up email for me to approve
lede: Relevance AI goes deeper on sales: AI agent teams, approvals reps answer in Slack or Teams, Python code steps and, on Enterprise, AI agent tests.

us: You are a small team that wants follow-ups drafted for approval, not an AI workforce for sales.
You want to start without a paid plan.
Sales is one of several jobs you want handled, next to finance and support.
them: You run outbound at volume and want prebuilt AI agent teams for Salesforce, HubSpot and Gong.
You test AI agents with evaluations before rolling them out, on Enterprise.
Your reps approve drafts from Slack or Teams.

move.title: List the AI agents that earn their keep
move.body: Write down each AI agent's job, the tools it calls and the steps that need approval.

move.title: Rebuild one as a sentence
move.body: Start with the follow-ups, using the ask at the top of this page. Captain asks which pipeline and when, then shows the plan.

move.title: Compare drafts for a week
move.body: Run both on live deals, compare the drafts your reps would send, then cancel.

faqs.q: Is there a free plan on either?
faqs.a: Relevance AI's free plan is retired; Pro is $19 a month billed yearly for 2,500 actions. 50agents is free to start.
Relevance AI says 2,000+ and lists 2,728 in its directory; 50agents works with 2,300+ through viaSocket.

faqs.q: Can both wait for approval before emailing a prospect?
faqs.a: Yes. Relevance AI has approval-required steps; 50agents holds every send to people outside in Needs you.
